hotel_name: Hilton Cancun, An All Inclusive Resort

claims.text: Rooms are minimalist in design, with a focus on light wood and creams.

findings.quote: With a focus on light wood and creams, all rooms are minimalist, yet thoughtfully designed.

claims.text: The resort has 12 all-inclusive dining options, including five specialty restaurants.

findings.quote: we’ve got you covered from morning til night with 12 all-inclusive dining options
Choose from five specialty restaurants for elevated all-inclusive dining.

claims.text: Auma is an open-fire mixed grill featuring prime cuts, where meals unfold in full view of fire and flame.

findings.quote: An experiential open-fire mixed grill, Auma features prime cuts and house specialties where meals unfold with ritualistic theatre in full view of fire and flame.

claims.text: The complimentary Kid's Club is for kids aged 4 to 12.

findings.quote: Their complimentary Kid’s Club is available for kids 4-12

claims.text: There is a tour company on site to help with excursions.

findings.quote: there is a tour company right onsite to help with any excursion needs

claims.text: The staff are bilingual in Spanish and English.

findings.quote: all staff I interacted with were bilingual and happy to converse in Spanish or English

claims.text: Rooms come with complimentary water in recycled glass bottles that the property cleans and repurposes.

findings.quote: All rooms come with recycled glass bottles of complimentary water that the property cleans and repurposes.

claims.text: Designated accessible rooms have roll-in showers and braille signage.

findings.quote: designated rooms that have roll-in showers and braille signage

claims.text: The resort is tucked deep in a mangrove forest and sits on the ocean's edge.

findings.quote: Tucked deep in a mangrove forest, the property sits on the ocean’s edge nestled amongst the trees and not much else.
Surrounded by lush mangroves and set on 100 acres of unspoiled Mayan coastline.

claims.text: The Deluxe Ocean Front Suite has a large living room with sofa and dining table, a king-sized bed and sitting area, two bathrooms and sweeping ocean front views.

findings.quote: We stayed in the Deluxe Ocean Front Suite
a large living room area with sofa and dining table, a king-sized bed and sitting area, and two bathrooms—all topped off by sweeping ocean front views

claims.text: Accommodations range from ocean-view rooms to options with private swim-up patios, for two to six people.

findings.quote: From ocean views to private swim-up patios, whether you’re looking to sleep two or six people you’ll find a wide range of accommodation offerings

claims.text: A dedicated family splash playground has slides, water toys and beach games.

findings.quote: the property’s dedicated family splash playground, which is a water wonderland featuring slides, water toys, and beach games

claims.text: A dedicated TeensZone for ages 13 to 17 has TV, video and board games, and ping pong tables.

findings.quote: a dedicated TeensZone space for ages 13-17 where teens have a relaxed area to watch TV, play video and board games, and compete at the ping pong tables

claims.text: The property is fairly isolated, and walking into Cancun town is not an option, so guests need to plan transportation ahead.

findings.quote: As mentioned, the property is fairly isolated.
you’ll need to plan ahead for transportation as walking into town is not an option

claims.text: Some specialty restaurants offer extra menu options for an additional fee.

findings.quote: some of the specialty restaurants do offer extra menu options for an additional fee

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the large resort may feel crowded during peak seasons.
